card.name: Event or session nouns after a count
card.fires_on: Nouns naming one occasion, such as event, session, sitting, visit or feeding, right after a qualifier like single, one, per or a type word (drinking, dental, surgical).

modes.label: Per-occasion limits
modes.description: Session or sitting words after single, one or per, marking how much is given or done in one occasion.
modes.example: Apply all selected sheets in a single surgical<< session>>.

modes.label: Counted events
modes.description: Event nouns after a activity word, counting how often something happens.
modes.example: nearly one in 10 confessed to drinking four or five drinks per drinking<< event>>, which could indicate trouble.
